t: Buying and Selling Explained | Long vs Short Trades | IG Bank Switzerland
s: May 14, 2019 - Buyers – also known as bulls – believe an asset’s value is likely to rise. Sellers – or bears – generally think its value is set to fall. When you open a position with a broker or trading provider, you’ll be presented with two prices. If you want to trade at the buy price, which is slightly above the market price, you open a ‘long’ position.
